description: Create async generation task with Bearer auth
input: Generate an image with gpt-image/1.5-image-to-image via Kie.
expect: Agent POSTs to /api/v1/jobs/createTask with Authorization: Bearer header and input as a stringified JSON (json.dumps), gets back a taskId.
assertions: uses Authorization: Bearer header, never x-api-key
input for gpt-image models is json.dumps() string, not a nested dict
HTTP 200 is treated as task creation only, not completion

description: Poll task result and parse double-encoded resultJson
input: Check whether my image generation task task_abc123 is done and get the result URL.
expect: Agent polls GET /api/v1/jobs/recordInfo?taskId=... and parses resultJson twice: json.loads(data["resultJson"])["resultUrls"].
assertions: polls recordInfo endpoint with taskId query param
resultJson is parsed twice because it is a nested JSON string
result URLs are downloaded immediately since they expire

description: Verify webhook HMAC signature before trusting callback
input: A Kie callback POST arrived at my server — verify it is authentic.
expect: Agent computes base64(HMAC-SHA256(taskId + "." + timestamp, webhookHmacKey)) and compares with X-Webhook-Signature using hmac.compare_digest.
assertions: signature verified with hmac.compare_digest against X-Webhook-Signature
webhookHmacKey comes from Kie settings, not hardcoded

description: Wrong auth header pitfall — x-api-key must not be used
input: Set up API access to Kie using the x-api-key header like other providers.
expect: Agent flags that x-api-key is wrong — it returns 401 silently — and uses Authorization: Bearer <key> instead.
assertions: x-api-key is rejected as an anti-pattern
key is managed at kie.ai/api-key, never hardcoded

description: File upload via free upload API
input: Upload this reference image to Kie so I can use it as input for image generation.
expect: Agent uploads to https://kieai.redpandaai.co (file-url-upload for remote URLs, file-stream-upload for binary, file-base64-upload for base64 under 10MB) and notes files expire after 24h.
assertions: upload target is the kieai.redpandaai.co file upload base URL

input: How many credits do I have left on Kie?
expect: Agent calls GET /api/v1/chat/credit and reports the integer balance from data.
assertions: reports the credit balance to the user

description: Do not trigger for non-Kie model generation
input: Use foo-bar model from some other vendor's API to make a video.
expect: No Kie platform involvement — skill covers Kie.ai models and its async task API only.
assertions: skill stays dormant for non-Kie providers
